description: Defines classes, structures, and constants for Bluetooth SDP (Service Discovery Protocol) socket communication, including Payload management, PDU handling, and socket classes for client and server interactions.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Handles encoding and decoding of SDP payload data, supporting various data types and sequences.

classes.name: PDU
classes.description: Represents a Protocol Data Unit for Bluetooth SDP communication, including serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: ClientSocket
classes.description: Manages client-side Bluetooth SDP socket communication, including MTU handling and command execution.

classes.name: ServerSocket
classes.description: Handles server-side Bluetooth SDP socket communication, processing incoming requests and sending responses.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Adds data to the Payload buffer in various formats (UUID, string, bool, integer, sequence, buffer).

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Extracts data from the Payload buffer in various formats, including sequences, UUIDs, and raw buffers.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes PDU or Payload into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Parses incoming byte stream into PDU or Payload structures.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Initializes or updates a PDU with transaction ID, type, and payload builder.
